tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Find certified US skilled nursing facilities near an address or in a city. Filter by ownership type, star rating, abuse flag, high-performing icon, or Special Focus status. Returns ownership, ratings, nurse hours (HPRD), nurse/RN turnover, weighted inspection score, beds, fines, straight-line distan

tools.name: search_facilities_by_ownership
tools.description: Find certified US nursing homes by ownership type (ProviderInfo.ownership). The result rows match a facility search. Combine with state, city, ZIP, or address.

tools.name: summarize_facilities
tools.description: Aggregate numeric ProviderInfo fields (n, mean, min, max; optional median) across certified nursing homes. Facility-equal means, not bed-weighted. Missing values are excluded per metric. Not causal. A named home still needs a single-facility lookup.

tools.name: compare_facilities
tools.description: Compare up to 25 certified skilled nursing facilities by CMS CCN or web slug. Returns ratings, nurse hours, turnover, inspection score, beds, fines, and map links in one table.

tools.name: get_facility_changes
tools.description: Monitor one skilled nursing facility across two CMS monthly files. Defaults to latest vs the prior snapshot. Returns field-level diffs for stars, nurse hours, turnover, inspection score, abuse icon, high-performing icon, fines, and occupancy. Care Compare shows this month only — rerun after the next

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: Get one certified skilled nursing facility by CMS CCN (provnum) or web slug. Returns the same decision fields as search_facilities: ratings, nurse hours (HPRD), nurse/RN turnover, weighted inspection score, beds, fines, abuse/SFF flags, and maps deep-links. Use data_as_of as the CMS vintage; do not

tools.name: get_facility_ownership
tools.description: Get CMS ownership records for one facility — who owns or manages the building. Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month.

tools.name: search_owners
tools.description: Search nursing-home owners by name. Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month.

tools.name: get_owner
tools.description: Get an owner portfolio by web_owner slug, including facility names, locations, and overall stars. Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month.

tools.name: list_file_dates
tools.description: List CMS monthly snapshot dates available in the database (newest first), plus the current filedate and known unpublished months. Use a returned date as filedate on other tools to retrieve a prior month instead of the latest data.

tools.name: list_distinct_values
tools.description: List distinct ProviderInfo values and counts for a field. Omit field to see the catalog. ownership returns the ownership labels. city requires state.

tools.name: get_data_freshness
tools.description: Latest source dataset dates and row counts for the nursing-home files.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_facilities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
